newsitem.title: USA: Big sees Q4 revs up 40 pct to $1.67 mln.
newsitem.headline: Big sees Q4 revs up 40 pct to $1.67 mln.

text.p: BIG Entertainment Inc said Tuesday that preliminary operating results for the third quarter show that the company's gross revenues increased by an estimated 40 percent to $1,667,000, compared with $1,194,116 in the corresponding period of the prior year.
Gross profit for the third quarter of 1996 improved to an estimated $574,000, versus a negative gross profit of ($122,640) in the corresponding period of the prior year.

The company said "revenue benefited from an approximate 14 percent increase in same-store sales in the company's Entertainment Super-Kiosk retail division for September 1996 from the corresponding period of the prior year."

It said that contributing factors to the overall increase in revenues were an expansion in the number of Entertainment Super-Kiosks to 25 with the recent opening of a unit in Ococc (Orlando), Florida as well as increased revenues in the company's book packaging and licensing division.

Preliminary results for the third quarter 1996 indicate that the company's operating losses continue to decline and the company expects this trend to continue during the fourth quarter of 1996. The company further expects revenue growth during the fourth quarter of 1996 and during 1997 and expects to achieve profitability during 1997.
